correctness.rationale: The C² matching condition yields the tridiagonal curvature equation. Its summable Green function follows by solving the characteristic equation and verifying the zero row; bounded polynomial pieces imply uniformly bounded nodal second derivatives, and the homogeneous equation has no nonzero bounded bi-infinite solution. The cubic pieces with the computed curvatures give existence and uniqueness. Summing translated unit steps against the ℓ¹ increments then reduces the exact quotient norm to the step. The central piece has positive derivative and variation one; reflection and geometric curvature ratios give two equal tails. The first right polynomial has equal endpoint ordinates and one interior turning point (its derivative has opposing endpoint signs), so its variation is twice the excursion, and successive tail cells scale by 2−sqrt(3) in absolute value. Independently rebuilt that polynomial and summed its overshoot geometrically to obtain exactly (2+sqrt(3)+2 sqrt(2−sqrt(3)))/3; replay /workspace/independent_exact_checks.py, cubic_cardinal(). The supplied finite natural-boundary stress tests were inspected only as optional corroboration, not used as whole-line evidence.
